name: MiniMax H3 — Observatory, extended
kind: continuation — a second generation conditioned on the final frame of an earlier run, then joined

source_run.note: the first half of the delivered file is this earlier render, unmodified

conditioning.method: final frame of the source clip extracted to PNG and used as the continuation's first frame

seam.method: mean absolute RGB difference between the source's final frame and the continuation's first frame, both resized to 432x240
seam.reading: 3.56/255 — within codec noise. The continuation reproduces the source's last frame almost exactly, so the join is frame-continuous rather than a cut.
seam.assembly: the continuation's duplicated first frame is dropped before joining, so the seam does not hold for two frames. No crossfade, no interpolation, no time remapping.
